given: one vehicle with checklists A and B and every role
the organization's default resume limit of 6 hours
a session opened before amendment 6.0.0 with a check after its deadline
when: each role starts A while an A session is in progress, and someone starts B
two people start A at the same instant
a participant reopens an ended A session while A is in progress, and again after it ends
time reaches the A session's deadline while it is in use
an Administrator changes the limit to 8 hours, and others try to change it or set 0 or 25
the session job runs late and then again
a crew member starts a new A session after the deadline
then: every start of A joins the one A session, and B gets its own session
the simultaneous starts produce one session
the reopen is refused while A is in progress and allowed afterwards before its own deadline
the session reads as Incomplete at its deadline before the job runs, and nothing can reopen, join or record into it
the job records one deadline event stamped at the deadline
the open session keeps its 6-hour deadline, a later session gets 8 hours, and the other changes are refused
with a 12-hour limit an idle session closes after 6 hours and can be reopened until its deadline
the legacy session reads and records the same end instant, its last check
the new session shows earlier checks as done and the earlier session is unchanged
notes: Language-neutral contract for draft SPEC amendment 6.0.0 (PR #254). The scenario is not yet bound to application commands.
